source: sars-guide:PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Rev 1 p. 10 (s11F 27.5% limit) and p. 12 (SDL on the balance of remuneration after allowable deductions)
notes: R20 000 salary, R8 000 retirement annuity (4006) through payroll, first period. The guide gives the rule, not these figures; computed by hand. s11F: min(8 000, 27.5% x 20 000 = 5 500, 430 000 / 12) = 5 500. PAYE: (20 000 - 5 500) x 12 = 174 000 x 18% = 31 320 - 17 820 = 13 500 / 12 = 1 125.00. SDL: 1% x (20 000 - 5 500) = 145.00 (#1142). UIF on the earning, capped: 177.12. Net 20 000 - 8 000 - 1 125 - 177.12.
